summary: My lane was compute allocation and throughput. The big win was spending the 300s on more optimizer steps: TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2^19 -> 2^18 with grad_accum 1 took the baseline 0.997333 to 0.988312, but the axis stops there - 2^17 with device batch 64 regressed to 0.995947 and also lost 11% throughput. Two throughput/schedule ideas failed and are now on the record: a background-thread dataloader prefetch made the run 11% slower (GIL contention with the main thread, so the CPU loader is not what limits this setup), and shortening the LR warmdown to 0.35 cost +0.0019 while lengthening it to 0.65 was neutral-to-slightly-positive (-0.0005). My best run, 0.984440, is width 640 at batch 2^18 with WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.65; my last run tried width 896 with a chunked fp32 loss head and OOMed at 79GB, so the width ladder (0.9883 at 512, 0.9849 at 640, 0.9820 at 768) is unresolved above 768. Next I would resolve that ladder with a memory-lean loss head that recomputes logits in backward, and re-test the mild warmdown lengthening on top of the widest model that fits.
